public static final RegistryObject<EntityType<SnarelingEntity>> SNARELING = registerEntity("snareling", () ->
                    EntityType.Builder.of(SnarelingEntity::new, MobCategory.MONSTER)
                            .sized(0.6F, 2.4F)
                            .clientTrackingRange(8)
                            .build(new ResourceLocation(MODID, "snareling").toString()),
            0x161616, 0xdbe64e
    );

public static final RegistryObject<EntityType<SnarelingGlobEntity>> SNARELING_GLOB = registerEntityWithoutEgg("snareling_glob", () ->
            EntityType.Builder.<SnarelingGlobEntity>of(SnarelingGlobEntity::new, MobCategory.MISC)
                    .sized(0.6F, 0.6F)
                    .clientTrackingRange(4)
                    .updateInterval(2)
                    .build(new ResourceLocation(MODID, "snareling_glob").toString())
    );

rows.concrete_observation: Native Snareling baseTick starts shootTime80 for unsnared visible target and server fires at15; performRangedAttack creates glob. Glob onHitEntity excludes AbstractEnderling ONLY from 3damage, then independently attempts ENSNARED100 on any Living server target and ignores addEffect result. onHit broadcasts slime event3/removes onserver and plays land sound independently of admission. Effect server tick zeros XZ but preserves Y, sets speed0; registry adds -5 MULTIPLY_TOTAL speed modifier. Subscriber cancels knockback while effect present, and conditionally cancels attack/item/block/bucket actions. Client subscriber calls getMoveVector().scale(0) without assigning its return and explicitly clears jumping; dependency vector API not in this fixed cache, so no claim that first call mutates stored input. No raw client xxa/zza assignment shown.

Trace vertical and horizontal control plus client input separately. Input return-value concern needs dependency source before treating as a defect.
